column -t -s, lines up a CSV (bytes compared); -o ' | ' output separator; whitespace table from stdin
getopt parses long options (--beta=x, --beta x, --alpha) and short ones; eval set -- loop in bash
getopt -T → rc 4 (enhanced getopt); unknown long option → 'unrecognized option', rc 1
colrm 2 3 removes columns; look PREFIX FILE finds sorted matches (look-read-fallback.patch: no mmap on slicc)
